title: Christmas gifts for Mum 2026 UK: 11 ideas at Black Friday prices
seoTitle: Christmas Gifts for Mum 2026 UK: 11 Ideas She'll Love
description: Christmas gifts for Mum 2026 at Amazon's Black Friday prices: a record-low Kindle Paperwhite, a half-price Revlon One-Step and a Sage Bambino Plus.
intro:
**Our best overall Christmas gift for Mum this year is the Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition at a record-low £139.99 on Amazon. Best cheap gift: the Revlon One-Step hair dryer and volumiser at £24.99, half price. Best splurge: the Sage Bambino Plus espresso machine at £359.**

Every price below is an Amazon UK Black Friday Week price published on 19 November 2026. The sale runs to 30 November, and some deals need Prime. Browse all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) for more.

deals.name: Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024)
deals.note: The top Paperwhite, with wireless charging, an auto-adjusting light and 32GB of storage. TechRadar called £139.99 a record low.

deals.name: Revlon Salon One-Step Hair Dryer and Volumiser
deals.note: Dries and styles in one go for a smooth, bouncy blow-dry at home. Half price and a record low, so it's the best cheap gift on this page.

deals.name: Oral-B iO Series 3 electric toothbrush
deals.note: A big step up from a basic brush, with a pressure sensor and a quiet magnetic motor. Under £50 is a very good price for an iO.

deals.name: Apple Watch Series 11 (42mm, GPS)
deals.note: For a mum with an iPhone: fitness tracking, sleep data and notifications on her wrist. £50 off in black or space grey; other colours are £40 off.

deals.name: Oura Ring 5 (black or silver)
deals.note: A smart ring that tracks sleep, activity and recovery without a screen on the wrist. You'll need her ring size, and the app needs a monthly subscription after the trial.

deals.name: Philips Hue Festavia string lights
deals.note: App-controlled Christmas lights that can twinkle, fade or show a gradient of colours. A treat for a mum who loves decorating the tree.

deals.name: LEGO Festive Gingerbread House
deals.note: A relaxing build for Christmas afternoon that stays out as a decoration every year after.

deals.name: Ninja Crispi 3.8L 4-in-1 glass air fryer
deals.note: A compact air fryer with glass dishes that go from the fridge to the fryer to the table. Suits a smaller kitchen or someone cooking for one or two.

deals.name: Sage The Bambino Plus espresso machine
deals.note: Café-style coffee and properly frothed milk at home, in a small footprint. Not its lowest-ever price, but it hasn't been cheaper for a couple of years.

deals.name: Kindle (2026)
deals.note: The entry-level Kindle at a record-low price, though the Paperwhite Signature Edition is only £20 more.

deals.name: Loop Quiet 2 ear plugs
deals.note: Soft, reusable ear plugs for a light sleeper or a noisy house. A neat stocking filler at a record-low price.

body:
## How to choose a Christmas gift for Mum

The best gifts for mums usually come in one of three types: something that saves her time, something just for her, or something for the hobby she never spends money on herself. If you're not sure which way to go, think about what she grumbles about. Can't get a decent blow-dry at home? Never finishes a book because the light's wrong at bedtime? Loves a good coffee but won't pay café prices?

- **A treat just for her:** a Kindle, a smart ring or a good hair tool.
- **A time saver:** a compact air fryer or a better toothbrush.
- **Christmas itself:** smart tree lights or a Lego gingerbread house to build on the day.

Every price on this page is an Amazon UK price published on 19 November 2026, the first day of Amazon's Black Friday Week sale, which runs until 30 November. Some deals are only for Prime members; a [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) unlocks them, and our [Prime trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time it.

## Which Mum gifts are worth it at these prices?

**Best overall: Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition, £139.99.** This is the one we'd buy. It has the warm, auto-adjusting light that makes reading in bed easier, plus wireless charging. At this price it's only £20 more than the basic Kindle, which is why we'd pay the difference; our [Kindle vs Paperwhite comparison](/guides/kindle-vs-kindle-paperwhite/) explains the rest. If she reads a lot, a [Kindle Unlimited free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) gives her a big library to start on, and our [Kindle Unlimited guide](/guides/kindle-unlimited-free-trial-uk/) covers whether it's worth keeping. Prefer listening? An [Audible free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/hz/audible/mlp) includes a free audiobook.

**Best cheap gift: Revlon One-Step, £24.99.** It's a cult favourite for a reason: it dries and volumises at the same time, so a salon-style blow-dry takes far less effort than a brush and dryer. Half price is the lowest it has been.

**Best splurge: Sage Bambino Plus, £359.** For the mum who loves coffee, it heats up in seconds and the automatic milk wand does the hard part. It's been cheaper in the past, so this is a good price, not a record low. If coffee is her thing, our [coffee machine deals guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/) compares more options.

**For the active mum:** the Apple Watch Series 11 (£269) suits iPhone users who want notifications and fitness tracking. The Oura Ring 5 (£299) is better for someone who mainly wants sleep tracking without wearing a watch, but remember the app needs a paid membership after the trial, and you'll need her ring size.

**For her bathroom:** the Oral-B iO Series 3 at £49.99 is far below its usual price. Pair it with something for her dressing table from our [perfume gift set deals](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/) for a bigger present.

For more ideas at a lower budget, see our [Christmas gifts for her under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-her-under-50/), or browse all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

## Good prices to look for

- Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition: under £140 is the best price yet.
- Revlon One-Step: £25 or less is the lowest it goes.
- Oral-B iO Series 3: anything under £60 is good.
- Sage Bambino Plus: under £360 is the best it has been for a couple of years.

## Buy now or wait?

Amazon's Black Friday Week prices are due to last until 30 November, but popular gifts like Kindles often sell out first. Prices usually go back up in December and the Boxing Day sales are too late for Christmas, so if you've found the right gift at one of these prices, buy it now.

## FAQs

### What's a good Christmas gift for a mum who has everything?

Something she'd never buy herself: a Kindle Paperwhite for reading in bed, a coffee machine, or smart Christmas lights. A gift she can use every day matters more than how much it costs.

### Kindle or Kindle Paperwhite for Mum?

At today's prices, the Paperwhite Signature Edition. It's only £20 more than the basic Kindle and adds a bigger, warmer screen, an auto-adjusting light, waterproofing and wireless charging.

### Is an Oura Ring a good gift?

Only if you know her ring size and she'll keep paying for the app, which needs a monthly membership after the free trial. If you're not sure, an Apple Watch (for iPhone users) or a simpler gift is safer.

### Will these prices go lower before Christmas?

Probably not. Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to 30 November, and prices usually rise in December until the Boxing Day sales start.
